deploy.on_merge: A merge deploys nothing: CI only tests and builds. cashloom.io is the Cloudflare Pages project cashloom-atlas, deployed by hand from a clean worktree of release/service-workspace-20260929: in atlas/, `bun run build`, then `wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name cashloom-atlas` with a preview --branch first and --branch main for production. A GitHub push webhook (644627819) notifies AWS Amplify on every push; commit subjects end with [skip-cd], and whether Amplify still builds is unverified (decision D6: no AWS calls).
deploy.after_deploy: Run atlas/tests/browser/release-smoke.mjs against the preview and against https://cashloom.io (it fails on any external request); compare the 8 served kit files with kit/web by sha256 and content type; expect old HTML answers for root paths such as /favicon.ico at some edges for up to 4 h, and cookieless HTML cached about 15 min; record the Pages deployment and its rollback target in STATE.md, as PR #24 did.
deploy.rules: /AGENTS.md: fixes to the live surfaces land on release/service-workspace-20260929 by pull request, never on main (ledger cl-live-line); commit subjects end with [skip-cd]. A production Pages deploy is an outward act and needs Yu's word for that release (artcraft-estate-wiring carried it for PR #23).

notes: atlas/tests/brand-kit.sync.test.ts runs in the atlas job of /.github/workflows/ci.yml (bun run test, which is `vitest run tests` in atlas/package.json) on pull requests into main, release/** and feature/**, and on pushes to main and release/**. Neither file names the test: vitest picks up the folder.
check.mjs is not wired yet. The proposal is a step `node ../brand/check.mjs` in the atlas job of .github/workflows/ci.yml, which is the lane's call.

The kit keeps the generator's own layout: its spec is inside it (kit/source/brand.json) and there is no brand/brand.json. Rebuild in place from brand/kit, as kit/BRAND.md says. The mark is drawn from type (Source Serif 4, bundled with vectorcraft-cli), so kit/source holds no mark file; Inter SemiBold and JetBrains Mono are bundled too.

Known differences, by design (PR #23): the share card, mark and lockup files use the generator's badge (0.22 radius, a smaller white 'c'), not the site's 0.28 badge with its pale 'c'; the card headline is Inter SemiBold, while the page sets headings in Fraunces (review 2026-11-02: card faces from the page wait for generator 1.9); og:image:alt calls the #255B46 tile 'dark teal', which is the generator's wording.

Not dressed by this folder: the private workspace app (sovereign/ui/index.html keeps its own data: favicon) and the INFO image, which .dockerignore builds from an allowlist that leaves brand/ and atlas/ out.

Review 2026-11-02, A1: /robots.txt and /manifest.json answered the SPA's HTML (still so live on 2026-11-10). Fixed in source outside this folder and the kit: atlas/public/robots.txt is the site's own plain allow-all (not a kit file, so not in serve.files), and atlas/functions/_middleware.ts answers 404 at /manifest.json, because the kit's manifest is /site.webmanifest and nothing links /manifest.json. Both reach cashloom.io with the next Pages deploy; STATE.md records deploys.
